header: 10s anime fight clip, 24fps, underground circular sand-and-concrete martial arts tournament pit, harsh golden-white overhead ring floodlights, dark tiered crowd in deep shadow, no ring ropes. STYLE: Pure 2D hand-drawn anime, Baki and Kengan Ashura style detailed anatomical muscle striations, cel-shaded flat colors with hard 2-tone high-contrast shadows, heavy ink outlines on A, broken sketchy ink on active smear limbs only, clean thick ink on impact holds, intense bare-knuckle stand-up sakuga animation on twos. Not 3D, not CGI, not live action, not photoreal. ENTITY COUNT: Exactly TWO shirtless bare-knuckle fighters (ZERO weapons). Fighter A (always on screen-left facing right): lean, striated martial artist, shirtless bare torso and arms, white cloth wrist/knuckle tape on both hands, red fight trunks, bare feet. Fighter B (always on screen-right facing left): towering, massive scarred pit-brawler, shirtless thick muscular torso, black fight pants, bare fists, bare feet. Maintain realistic strike spacing at all times: one full arm's length (0.75-0.85m) for punches and one full leg's length (1.05-1.15m) for kicks so the bodies never merge. Execute as one continuous two-way center-ring war; no on-screen text, no numbers, no HUD, and no coordinate labels.
name: baki_underground_pit_two_way_standup_war_10s
axes: Y_up, metres, sand arena floor y=0, center-ring stand-up pocket z=2.8 to z=5.0, A stays on screen_left (z=2.85 to 3.55) facing +Z right for all 10s, B stays on screen_right (z=3.95 to 5.0) facing -Z left for all 10s
screen_geometry: 180_degree_camera_rule_locked_for_all_10s: Fighter A remains strictly on screen_left facing right (+Z) and Fighter B remains strictly on screen_right facing left (-Z) for the entire 10.0s clip (zero side swaps). Punches connect at one full arm's length (0.75-0.85m torso separation) and kicks connect at one full leg's length (1.05-1.15m torso separation).
negative: no 3D CGI, no mocap stiffness, no floaty physics, no wall run, no ground punch, no weapons, no swords, no knives, no kunai, no side swap, no torso merging, no chest-to-chest clipping, no on-screen text or numbers, no HUD, no coordinate labels, no extra fighters, no cloned A or B, no missing limbs, no missing arms, no one-armed fighter, no extra legs, no deformed legs, no fist-leg hybrid, no full-body blur during smears, no reaction before contact
conservation_laws: CONSERVE_SEMANTICALLY: every strike and counter is unrolled into sequential sub-beats for entry/windup -> drive/turnover -> full-reach contact -> recoil/follow-through

realistic_strike_reach_spacing: punches connect at one full arm's length (0.75-0.85m between torso centers), kicks connect at one full leg's length (1.05-1.15m between torso centers), and clinches hold 0.60-0.65m separation so bodies never merge
strict_screen_side_lock: A stays on screen_left facing right (+Z) and B stays on screen_right facing left (-Z) for all 10.0 seconds

two_way_exchange_war: B lands a heavy right cross counter at 5.45s that skids A backward before A counters with an in-place spinning back kick at 6.50s and a deep-lunge straight right knockout at 8.80s
